name: Studio - Email Post with Featured Image (tool)

parameters.prompt: =Create a professional 1024x1024 featured image for a cybersecurity blog post titled "{{ $('Normalize Inputs').item.json.title }}". Abstract professional design incorporating Lazarus Alliance brand colors (burnt orange #d34a28, golden yellow #d39f28, dark gray #404040). Include the blog post title as prominent text overlay. Clean geometric shapes, subtle gradients, modern tech elements, cybersecurity metaphors (shields, locks, networks, data flow). Professional, authoritative, high-tech aesthetic for an enterprise blog.

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: =Email sent to {{ $('Normalize Inputs').item.json.to }}{{ $('Normalize Inputs').item.json.includeImage === 'yes' ? ' with a featured image' : '' }}.
